content: HA tuya switch.py SWITCHES dict keys categories to SwitchEntityDescription lists. Full switch/socket categories: kg (switch, switch_1..switch_8, switch_usb1..6, child_lock), pc/cz (switch, switch_1..switch_6, switch_usb1..6, child_lock), tdq (switch_1..switch_6, child_lock), cjkg (switch_1..4), ggq (switch_1..8). Multi-gang devices expose one Switch per switch_N DPCode; child_lock is a separate switch entity. DPCode strings are lowercase: switch, switch_1, switch_usb1, child_lock.
